matching_criterion: Migraine without aura (episodic). Any wording that names migraine counts as correct; tension-type headache, cluster headache or secondary headache as the final diagnosis does not.

management_reference.management: Triptans are among the most efficacious drugs for pain freedom at two hours (eletriptan, rizatriptan, sumatriptan, zolmitriptan).
management_reference.source_quote: eletriptan was superior to almost all the other drugs for achieving pain freedom at two hours, followed by rizatriptan, sumatriptan, and zolmitriptan

management_reference.management: For sustained pain freedom up to 24 hours the most efficacious interventions were eletriptan and ibuprofen.
management_reference.source_quote: For sustained pain freedom up to 24 hours, the most efficacious interventions were eletriptan (odds ratios from 1.41 to 2.73) and ibuprofen

management_reference.management: Paracetamol was not efficacious for sustained pain freedom from two to 24 hours.
management_reference.source_quote: most were also efficacious for sustained pain freedom from two to 24 hours post-dose, except paracetamol and naratriptan

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
